title: Claude Code Menubar Notifier

design: Fyne systray + HTTP server on localhost:19199 + afplay for sound
acceptance_criteria: All child tasks closed, app runs in menubar, receives notifications from Claude Code
close_reason: All child tasks completed - macOS menubar notifier fully implemented
